built_from.note: Same file set as code_diver_pier: 24503 files (kb/ + 10 populated submodules at their pinned commits); the other 8 submodules are empty and not indexed; .github/ has no indexed files. Qdrant holds file_summary + file_manifest points for all 24503 files (49006 points, includes vendor/ files); the graph artifacts and the Rust catalog cover the 16450 non-vendor items (same as code_diver_pier).

code_diver.note: index built with the Python indexer from a working tree with uncommitted changes in native/ and scripts/serve_reranker.sh only; Rust artifacts via scripts/dump_rust_catalog.py

embedding.serving: llama.cpp llama-server build 9430 (d48a56eff), --embedding --pooling last -c 16384 -np 4 -b 4096 -ub 4096; EOS token appended by the GGUF tokenizer, do not add another; L2-normalized output
embedding.query_prefix: Represent this code search query for retrieving relevant files:
embedding.document_prefix: Represent this code file metadata for retrieval:
embedding.note: Vectors are NOT compatible with code_diver_pier (MLX 4-bit DWQ). Queries must be embedded by this GGUF model with the query prefix; the Rust binary sends the raw query, so the embedder endpoint (sidecar) must prepend query_prefix.

reranker.serving_note: use -b/-ub >= 4096 (-c 16384 -np 4): with 2048 one second-pass pair of 2049 tokens failed in validation

validation.tool: Rust code_diver_search_bin (copy of target/release build of 2026-10-04), per-query one-shot, candidate_limit 64, LightGBM meta-ranker on, same reranker for both sides, query prefix prepended by a forwarding proxy
validation.acceptance_rule: FileHit@5 and @10 within 2 pp of old or better on both datasets
validation.result: hard FileHit@5 -5.0 pp (sample60) / -4.4 pp (full) with the meta-ranker: rule NOT met; without the meta-ranker hard @5 0.0 pp, @10 -1.1 pp; code and raw-vector level not worse
